title: Partition by Fourier degree cutoff
statement: For each natural number $n$, let $t_n$ be the floor of $\frac n2+\frac n2\sqrt{\frac{2\log(48n)}{n}}$. Among all subsets of an $n$-element set, the number having size at most $t_n$ plus the number having size greater than $t_n$ equals $2^n$.
